name: Dot Swing Button
description: A CSS button hover for React: the dot rocks away round a pivot while three coloured dots swing in one after another like a little colour wheel, and the label tips back and lifts out as a copy swings up into its place, all on an elastic ease. Dashed outline, press squash, keyboard focus plays it too. No JavaScript.
